title: Ôn tập Giữa kì 1 · Kỹ năng Viết (Writing Skills)

items.prompt:
Question 1. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Lan: Maybe I can help you. What windows do you need to clean?
b. Nam: Can you help me clean these windows? I can’t stand cleaning windows.
c. Nam: I need to clean the windows in front of the house. I’ve already done the ones in the back of the house.
options: A. a – b – c
B. c – b – a
C. b – a – c
D. c – a – b
items.explanation: Nam nhờ vả (b) -> Lan đồng ý và hỏi cần lau cửa nào (a) -> Nam chỉ rõ vị trí cửa sổ (c).

items.prompt:
Question 2. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Anna: Hi! How have you been? How’s your family?
b. John: Hey! I’ve been good, thanks. My parents are doing well, and my sister just started college. How about your family?
c. Anna: That’s great to hear! My family is good too — my brother just got a new job, so we’re all excited.
options: A. a – b – c
B. c – a – b
C. b – c – a
D. a – c – b
items.explanation: Anna chào hỏi thăm gia đình (a) -> John đáp và hỏi lại (b) -> Anna hào hứng chia sẻ về gia đình mình (c).

items.prompt:
Question 3. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Son: That’s a great idea! I can also make a birthday card for her.
b. Son: Dad, Mom’s birthday is this weekend. Should we do something special for her?
c. Father: Yes, definitely. I was thinking we could cook her favorite meal and buy her a nice gift.
options: A. b – c – a
B. c – b – a
C. b – a – c
D. a – b – c
items.explanation: Con trai nhắc ngày sinh nhật mẹ và hỏi ý kiến bố (b) -> Bố gợi ý nấu ăn và tặng quà (c) -> Con trai khen ý tưởng và đề nghị làm thiệp (a).

items.prompt:
Question 4. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement of sentences to make a meaningful exchange:
a. Daughter: I agree. It will also give us more time to relax together.
b. Mother: That would be wonderful. It’s important that we all share the chores to keep the house clean.
c. Mother: That’s very responsible of you! You could start by doing the dishes after dinner and helping with the laundry on weekends.
d. Daughter: Mom, I feel like I should help more around the house. What can I do to help?
e. Daughter: That sounds fair. I can also vacuum the living room twice a week.
options: A. d – b – a – e – c
B. d – b – a – c – e
C. a – b – c – d – e
D. d – c – e – b – a
items.explanation: Con gái chủ động đề nghị giúp đỡ việc nhà (d) -> Mẹ gợi ý rửa bát và giặt đồ (c) -> Con đồng ý và nhận thêm hút bụi (e) -> Mẹ vui mừng khen ngợi việc cùng chia sẻ việc nhà (b) -> Con đồng tình rằng sẽ có nhiều thời gian nghỉ ngơi cùng nhau (a).

items.prompt:
Question 5. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful letter:
Hi Emily,
I hope you're doing well. I wanted to share something personal with you because I trust you.
a. Lately, I’ve been feeling a bit sad because my parents are not getting along. They argue a lot, and it’s making things really difficult at home.
b. Thanks for listening. I hope we can meet this weekend, maybe talking in person would help.
c. It’s hard to concentrate at school, and I don’t really feel like talking to anyone about it. I just needed to tell someone, and I thought of you.
d. Have you ever been through something like this? If you have any advice, I’d really appreciate it.
e. I’m not sure what’s going to happen, but I’m scared they might separate.
Take care, Anna
options: A. e – a – c – d – b
B. a – e – c – d – b
C. e – d – a – c – b
D. a – d – c – e – b
items.explanation: Anna tâm sự bố mẹ cãi nhau (a) -> sợ bố mẹ ly hôn (e) -> ảnh hưởng tâm lý và việc học ở trường (c) -> hỏi xin lời khuyên của bạn (d) -> cảm ơn và hẹn gặp (b).

items.prompt:
Question 6. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful paragraph:
a. This not only reduces stress for parents but also teaches children how to work as part of a team.
b. When children take part in tasks like washing dishes, doing laundry, or sweeping the floor, they learn responsibility and important life skills.
c. Although housework may not always be enjoyable, it brings the family closer and builds respect for one another.
d. In a family, it is important that everyone helps with household chores so the home stays clean and organized.
e. Doing chores together can also be a great time for family members to talk, share stories, and strengthen their bond.
options: A. b – d – a – c – e
B. d – e – b – a – c
C. d – b – a – e – c
D. b – a – d – c – e
items.explanation: d (Câu chủ đề: Mọi người cần giúp việc nhà) -> b (Khi trẻ làm việc nhà sẽ học được tính trách nhiệm) -> a (Điều này giảm áp lực cho bố mẹ và dạy kỹ năng làm việc nhóm) -> e (Cùng làm việc nhà giúp gắn kết) -> c (Kết luận: việc nhà đem lại sự gần gũi và tôn trọng lẫn nhau).

items.prompt:
Question 7. Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct arrangement to make a meaningful paragraph:
a. Music strongly influences the human mind because it can shape both our emotions and our thoughts.
b. When people listen to gentle melodies, they often experience a sense of calm, which reduces stress and helps them think more clearly.
c. For these reasons, music is more than entertainment; it is also a powerful tool for emotional balance and mental growth.
d. However, upbeat and energetic songs create a different effect, since they boost motivation and encourage people to stay active.
e. This clear state of mind is useful for studying or working, as soft background music can improve focus and productivity.
options: A. e – a – b – d – c
B. a – b – d – c – e
C. a – b – e – d – c
D. e – d – b – a – c
items.explanation: a (Câu chủ đề: Âm nhạc tác động mạnh đến tâm trí) -> b (Giai điệu nhẹ nhàng giúp thư thái, bình tĩnh) -> e (Tâm trí sáng suốt này giúp ích cho học tập, làm việc) -> d (Ngược lại, nhạc sôi động giúp tăng động lực) -> c (Kết luận: âm nhạc là công cụ cân bằng cảm xúc).

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
1. Alex was instructing all the workers of the company.
All the workers ____________________
model_answers: All the workers of the company were being instructed by Alex.
All the workers were being instructed by Alex.
items.explanation: Câu bị động thì Quá khứ tiếp diễn: 'was/were + being + V3/ed'. Đáp án: 'All the workers of the company were being instructed by Alex.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
2. My mother lets me go out with my friends on Sundays.
My mother allows me ____________________
model_answers: My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'let someone + V-bare' = 'allow someone + to-V'. Đáp án: 'My mother allows me to go out with my friends on Sundays.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
3. The local people have arranged to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.
The local people are going ____________________
model_answers: The local people are going to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.
items.explanation: Diễn đạt kế hoạch đã sắp xếp dùng 'be going to + V': 'The local people are going to plant more trees in the neighbourhood this weekend.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
4. I advised you to prepare your lesson at home.
You had better ____________________
model_answers: You had better prepare your lesson at home.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ: 'advise someone to-V' = 'had better + V-bare'. Đáp án: 'You had better prepare your lesson at home.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
5. His parents don’t allow him to watch such TV shows.
His parents don’t let ____________________
model_answers: His parents don’t let him watch such TV shows.
His parents don't let him watch such TV shows.
items.explanation: 'not allow someone to-V' = 'not let someone + V-bare'. Đáp án: 'His parents don’t let him watch such TV shows.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence so that it means the same as the sentence before it:
6. We divide household chores equally in our family.
Household chores ____________________
model_answers: Household chores are divided equally in our family.
items.explanation: Câu bị động Hiện tại đơn: 'S + am/is/are + V3/ed': 'Household chores are divided equally in our family.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence using the cue in bracket:
7. Jaine last visited her hometown 3 years ago. (has)
Jaine ____________________
model_answers: Jaine has not visited her hometown for 3 years.
Jaine hasn't visited her hometown for 3 years.
items.explanation: 'last + V2 + time + ago' chuyển sang thì Hiện tại hoàn thành dạng phủ định: 'has not (hasn't) visited her hometown for 3 years.'

items.prompt:
Finish the sentence using infinitive verb:
8. My cousin spent three hours driving to the concert hall.
It took ____________________
model_answers: It took my cousin three hours to drive to the concert hall.
items.explanation: 'spend time V-ing' = 'It takes/took someone + time + to-V'. Đáp án: 'It took my cousin three hours to drive to the concert hall.'

items.prompt:
Combine the two sentences using 'When':
9. Nick and Judy were arguing about the case. Chief Bogo called them. (called)
When ____________________
model_answers: When Chief Bogo called them, Nick and Judy were arguing about the case.
When Nick and Judy were arguing about the case, Chief Bogo called them.
items.explanation: Hành động đang xảy ra (Quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì hành động khác xen vào (Quá khứ đơn): 'When Chief Bogo called them, Nick and Judy were arguing about the case.'

items.prompt:
Change into passive voice:
10. A small company introduced the first e-reader in 1999.
The first ____________________
model_answers: The first e-reader was introduced by a small company in 1999.
items.explanation: Câu bị động Quá khứ đơn: 'was/were + V3/ed + by O': 'The first e-reader was introduced by a small company in 1999.'
